title: Fix goroutine leak in saga rollback and add timeout
description:
**Bug**: `core/controlplane/scheduler/engine.go:611-615` fires unbounded goroutine with `context.Background()` for saga rollback. No timeout, no cancellation, no goroutine pool.

**Fix**: Use a context with timeout (e.g. 30s), or better, submit to a bounded worker pool. At minimum add a timeout context and log duration.

**Files**: `core/controlplane/scheduler/engine.go`, `core/controlplane/scheduler/saga.go`
definitionOfDone: Saga rollback goroutine has a timeout context

implementationPlan.description: Run `go test ./core/controlplane/scheduler/...` to verify no regressions.

reopenReason: DoD #3 not met: "Test covers timeout scenario" — no new test was added. Need a test that: (1) creates a mock saga whose Rollback blocks or sleeps longer than the timeout, (2) triggers the rollback goroutine via a FAILED_FATAL result, (3) verifies the context deadline is exceeded (rollback returns context.DeadlineExceeded). Alternatively, a unit test that calls saga.Rollback with an already-expired context and verifies the error.
